verdicts.why: The wiki calls Carina the Collector's 'former slave' (only 'regarded as an assistant'). Servitude is being held, and it is also a workplace. 'Tivan Group' is not a group the dataset uses, so this unsure case keeps what's there.

The wiki says he left S.H.I.E.L.D. after Janet's disappearance, before the episode ('Used to work... Not anymore'). In episode 11 he only joins the Avengers team that S.H.I.E.L.D. assembled. His affiliation reads S.H.I.E.L.D. (formerly), Avengers.
The infobox lists Starforce as (formerly), and in episode 11 she is already undercover as USAF Dr. Wendy Lawson. Nothing in the episode shows Starforce membership, so that stage is backstory.
The wiki's 'Early Life' gives the Culver IT internship as a past internship, with Culver marked (formerly). In episode 12 she is a Stark Industries intern only.

In episode 16 Odin casts her out of Asgard on screen, and later he yields the throne to her as Queen of Asgard. Both are real moves. Ta Lo only gives her refuge and training: her wiki affiliation lists only Asgard, and the dataset uses no 'Ta Lo' group, so that stage is dropped.
In episode 13 the Sakaarans crown her King of Sakaar after the Grandmaster falls, and she accepts. 'Sakaar' is a group the dataset already uses.
He starts as a prisoner forced to race, which doesn't count as membership. After the Grandmaster falls, King Valkyrie makes him her special counsel and he accepts, so he joins Sakaar's new regime.

In season 3 (episodes 24-25) Ultron agrees to atone and joins Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm to rescue Carter and the Watcher. The wiki section is 'Joining the Guardians of the Multiverse', a group the dataset uses. His death is not a departure.

Episode 21 opens with him as a Soviet super soldier under Dreykov, and the infobox lists Soviet Armed Forces as (formerly). He breaks away and escapes, then accepts Bill Foster's S.H.I.E.L.D. job offer ('Recruited by S.H.I.E.L.D.'). He is an Avenger in 2012.

In the Episode 4 page, Wanda brings the zombified Yelena into the Paris battle to attack Kamala. The infobox gives Survivor Groups (formerly) and Red Queen's Army, the same pattern as the existing Hope and Okoye records.
In Episode 4 the zombified Melina is sent against Kamala in Paris. The infobox gives Survivor Groups (formerly) and Red Queen's Army, matching the Hope and Okoye pattern.
In Episode 4 the zombified Red Guardian is sent against Kamala in Paris. The infobox gives Survivor Groups (formerly) and Red Queen's Army.
In Episode 4 Shang-Chi and Katy face the zombified Jimmy Woo in Wanda's horde. The infobox gives FBI (formerly), Survivor Groups (formerly) and Red Queen's Army.
In Episode 4 Shang-Chi and Katy face the zombified Death Dealer in Wanda's horde. The infobox gives Ten Rings (formerly), Survivor Groups (formerly) and Red Queen's Army.
In X2 Stryker captures Xavier and holds him at Alkali Lake. Being captured or held is not a move under the owner's rules.

The Horsemen kidnapping in Apocalypse is a capture, not a move. After Dark Phoenix the wiki still lists his X-Men affiliation as current, not formerly. He steps down only as headmaster, and Deadpool 2 shows him with the X-Men, so this unsure case keeps the record.

Both proposed Weapon X stages are imprisonment: the Three Mile Island cell in Origins, and the capture and brainwashing at Alkali Lake in X2. Captures and mind control are not moves. He is taken to Xavier's school at the end of Origins, but the X-Men stage from X-Men (2000) stays, since this is unsure.

In Dark Phoenix the wiki says the Phoenix Force possessed her and Vuk manipulated her while she fled. Her affiliation still reads X-Men, not formerly. A possessed or manipulated flight that she reverses in the same film is unsure, so the record stays.
Same as A:fox-jean-grey-young: the Phoenix possessed her and Vuk manipulated her while she fled, and her wiki affiliation remains X-Men. This is not a clear quit.
Magneto tranquilizes and captures Rogue and uses her to power his machine. Being captured or held is not a move.
In Apocalypse Stryker captures Hank, Raven, Moira and Peter and holds them in a cell at Alkali Lake. Captures are not moves.
Stryker captures Moira and locks her in an Alkali Lake cell, and she later has him arrested for kidnapping her. A capture is not a move, so her CIA stage stays as it is.
Stryker captures the group and imprisons them in a cell at Alkali Lake. A capture is not a move, and the X-Men stage from Apocalypse already covers what follows.
Same as A:fox-raven-darkholme: being imprisoned by Stryker at Alkali Lake is a capture, not a move.
